name: Hierarchical LOD for 3D Gaussian Splitting
definition: A tree-based hierarchy with interior and leaf nodes for each chunk of a scene, where every node is associated with a 3D Gaussian (either a leaf from original optimization or a merged interior node) to enable Level-of-Detail (LOD) rendering.
summary: Hierarchical LOD for 3D Gaussian Splitting enables real-time rendering of large scenes by organizing primitives into a tree-based hierarchy with dynamic, screen-size-based level-of-detail cuts.
